memoryFunctionTests.scope: Isolated tests of extracted application functions and patched functions with explicit transport/state stubs; not native renderer validation

tests.name: Complete small histories preserve all turns, order, timeline and completion cursor
Single-page loading preserves the continuation cursor
Large full history stops before exhaustion and releases every observed turn after GC
Stale state and request failures release reservations without reporting completion
Concurrent loads share the 256 MiB pending-data budget
Actual native main-process bundle enforces the same pending budget and protected byte eviction
Original canonical-state commit caller preserves completeness on success and never marks budget-stopped history complete
Eviction trims both many small items and fewer than 1000 large items, retaining viewport and reload anchors
Visible and in-progress items remain protected from eviction
Agent restoration uses verified ancestry, rejects cross-host/invalid descendants and never drains parent history
Layout changes cannot cascade pages; one scroll fetch and explicit retry still work

checks: Numeric version comparison including greater build components
Same and older releases are not advertised as newer
Offline failure reported without modifying the app

nativeSoakNote: Earlier build with identical history repair, before later launcher and update integration; see EVIDENCE.json
